JUDGMENT
Non-Reportable
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
                   CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 272-273 OF 2016
(arising out of S.L.P.(Civil) Nos.17642-17643 of 2014)
         
   GUJARAT WATER SUPPLY & SEWERAGE BOARD          ... APPELLANT(S) 
                VS.
   JASUBHAI KABHAI HARIJAN ETC.
 ... RESPONDENT(S)
J U D G M E N T
Anil R. Dave, J.
1.
Leave granted.
2.
In view of the judgement delivered in  Jogendrasinhji
Vijaysinghji v.  State of Gujarat  (2015) 9 SCC 1, we set
aside  the  judgment  of  the  Division  Bench  and  restore  the
Letters Patent Appeal to its original number to be decided on
its merits afresh.
3.
Parties  shall  appear  before  the  High  Court  on  15th
February, 2016.
4.
In view of the above, the appeals are allowed with no
order as to costs.
